code_release_commitment: The generation code (adapted generator, answer verifier, label-review tools) will be published on GitHub together with the paper.

marc_en.hub: SetFit/amazon_reviews_multi_en (copy of the English part of the Multilingual Amazon Reviews Corpus)
marc_en.licence: MARC licence terms (academic research only; no republication)

amazon_hpc_en.licence: none declared for the review text

partition: Each cleaned source is split 10% development / 90% test by a SHA-256 hash of its normalised text; exact duplicates (and, for MASSIVE, an utterance and its translation) always fall on the same side. No record is in both splits.

tokenizer.name: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
tokenizer.use: document sizing and the n_tokens field only

seeds: Every random choice of a document is seeded from a SHA-256 of its identifiers (source, split, length or record count, margin, document index, and for the main set the redraw number `attempt`). Each document records its `seed`; the main set also records the label-mix `temperature`. Rebuilding gives byte-identical files.
generator: Documents and questions were built with an adapted version of the OOLONG-synth generator (Bertsch et al., 2025, MIT licence), with Turkish record lines and question templates. The adapted code is released with the paper.
verification: recompute_answers.py recomputes every answer from the labelled records (0 disagreements on this release).
